notToBeConfusedWith.name: Evaporated milk
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Milk with about sixty per cent of its water removed; it is roughly twice as concentrated and will not stand in by volume.

forms.label: Whole milk
forms.sourceNote: Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat, with added vitamin D. Public domain. The record's own fluid-ounce portion gives 1.0313 g/ml, adopted as a true density because milk is poured rather than packed.

forms.label: Semi-skimmed milk
forms.sourceNote: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D. Public domain. Sold as semi-skimmed in Britain and Ireland and as 2% or reduced-fat in North America. The density is the record's own quart portion, a liquid measure, so it is a true density.
